bio.text: Mike Rulli represents Ohio's 6th Congressional District in the U.S. House, having won a special election in 2024.
Before Congress he served eight years on the Leetonia School Board and nearly two terms in the Ohio Senate, representing Mahoning, Columbiana and Carroll counties.
A lifelong Mahoning Valley resident, he worked in his family's Rulli Bros. Market, serving as its Director of Operations, and lives in Salem, Ohio.
